spec.title: Access decisions
spec.description:
Forward-auth checks by outcome.
- **No session**: a browser sent to the sign-in portal (302, 303) or another client refused (401).
- **Forbidden**: a signed-in user the policy does not permit.

spec.title: Sign-in attempts
spec.description:
Successes are password checks; a session resumed from a cookie is not one.
- `1FA` is the password.
- Failures include attempts refused under a ban.

spec.expr:
sum by (factor) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/authelia"} |= `Unsuccessful `
| regexp `Unsuccessful (?P<factor>\S+) authentication attempt by user '(?P<user>[^']+)'`
| logfmt remote_ip
| user != `` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Banned
spec.description: Attempts refused because regulation had already banned the user or the source address.

spec.expr:
sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/authelia"} |= `authentication attempt by user` |= `and they are banned until`
[$__interval]))
or vector(0)

spec.title: Endpoints
spec.description: Discovery and JWKS are served from memory; authorization, token and userinfo reach the database and the session store.

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: Peak per bucket: the line follows the tops of the garbage collector's sawtooth.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: CPU time as a share of one core: 250% is 2.5 cores.
Newest lines from the Authelia container; its database and session store are not included.

spec.title: Sign-ins
spec.description: Successful password checks, from the portal and from HTTP Basic. A session resumed from a cookie is not one.

spec.title: Granted
spec.description: Forward-auth checks that let a request through to a protected site.

spec.title: No session
spec.description: Requests to a protected site without a session.

spec.title: Forbidden
spec.description: Signed-in users the access policy does not permit.

spec.title: No session by site
spec.description: Requests to a protected site without a session: a browser is sent to the sign-in portal, any other client is refused with 401.

spec.expr:
sum by (key, site, remote_ip) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/authelia"} |= `Access to `
| regexp `Access to '?(?P<url>[^' ]+)'? (?:\(method \S+\) )?is (?P<verdict>not authorized|forbidden) to user '?(?P<user>[^',]+)`
| logfmt remote_ip
| label_format site=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^[a-z]+://([^/:]+).*$" .url "${1}" }}`
| site != ``
| verdict = `not authorized`
| label_format key=`{{ .site }} · {{ .remote_ip }}` [$__range]))

max by (key) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/authelia"} |= `Access to `
| regexp `Access to '?(?P<url>[^' ]+)'? (?:\(method \S+\) )?is (?P<verdict>not authorized|forbidden) to user '?(?P<user>[^',]+)`
| logfmt remote_ip
| label_format site=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^[a-z]+://([^/:]+).*$" .url "${1}" }}`
| site != ``
| verdict = `not authorized`
| label_format key=`{{ .site }} · {{ .remote_ip }}`
| label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000

sum by (key, user, site) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/authelia"} |= `Access to `
| regexp `Access to '?(?P<url>[^' ]+)'? (?:\(method \S+\) )?is (?P<verdict>not authorized|forbidden) to user '?(?P<user>[^',]+)`
| logfmt remote_ip
| label_format site=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^[a-z]+://([^/:]+).*$" .url "${1}" }}`
| site != ``
| verdict = `forbidden`
| label_format key=`{{ .user }} · {{ .site }}` [$__range]))

max by (key) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/authelia"} |= `Access to `
| regexp `Access to '?(?P<url>[^' ]+)'? (?:\(method \S+\) )?is (?P<verdict>not authorized|forbidden) to user '?(?P<user>[^',]+)`
| logfmt remote_ip
| label_format site=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^[a-z]+://([^/:]+).*$" .url "${1}" }}`
| site != ``
| verdict = `forbidden`
| label_format key=`{{ .user }} · {{ .site }}`
| label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000

sum by (key, user, remote_ip, factor) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/authelia"} |= `Unsuccessful `
| regexp `Unsuccessful (?P<factor>\S+) authentication attempt by user '(?P<user>[^']+)'`
| logfmt remote_ip
| user != ``
| label_format key=`{{ .user }} · {{ .remote_ip }} · {{ .factor }}` [$__range]))

max by (key) (max_over_time({syslog_id="docker/authelia"} |= `Unsuccessful `
| regexp `Unsuccessful (?P<factor>\S+) authentication attempt by user '(?P<user>[^']+)'`
| logfmt remote_ip
| user != ``
| label_format key=`{{ .user }} · {{ .remote_ip }} · {{ .factor }}`
| label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000

spec.title: Failed sign-ins
spec.description: Both factors, including attempts refused under a ban and ones the directory could not answer.

spec.expr:
sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/authelia"} |= `Unsuccessful `
| regexp `Unsuccessful (?P<factor>\S+) authentication attempt by user '(?P<user>[^']+)'`
| logfmt remote_ip
| user != ``
[$__interval]))
or vector(0)

spec.name: errors_only
spec.label: Errors only
spec.description: Show only warnings and errors in the log. Lines Loki cannot classify are kept — their level is unknown, not low.
